caption: Assens Harbour, Assens
composition: Mole, harbour basin, and the town behind · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the outer mole, Assens harbour is a dark basin of moored boats, with low town roofs and Vor Frue's tower behind the quay: a square brick shaft, an octagonal Gothic upper stage, and a slender spire. The night is overcast, about 12.7°C, and the Little Belt is open beyond the mole. The mole is quiet. No boat name or shop sign is readable.
